_note: Curated odoo.tools symbols for Odoo 20.0, verified against odoo/odoo 20.0 @ 530bc2789e2f (odoo/tools/__init__.py and the submodules it re-exports). Status doc of tools_symbol.schema.json applies: a name that no longer resolves is 'removed' and omitted. OMITTED (no longer resolve off odoo.tools at 20.0): ustr (no ustr remains under odoo/: odoo/loglevels.py defines only exception_to_unicode and odoo/tools/misc.py imports only that), Query (lives in odoo/orm/query.py, re-exported as odoo.models.Query), ormcache_context (no longer defined), get_encodings, pycompat, convert_csv_import, convert_sql_import, convert_xml_import, and the sql helpers that 'from .sql import *' used to flatten (create_index, index_exists, escape_psql, make_identifier, ...; odoo/tools/__init__.py now imports only SQL and drop_view_if_exists from .sql). street_split and mod10r resolve only as odoo.tools.business_data.street_split / .mod10r. DEPRECATED: odoo.tools.ormcache is not bound in odoo/tools/__init__.py; a module-level __getattr__ (odoo/tools/__init__.py:22-28) serves it, and 'cache', with a DeprecationWarning 'Since 20.0 import ormcache from odoo.api'. NEW at 20.0: BinaryBytes and BinaryValue (flat re-exports of odoo/tools/binary.py). PACKAGES: odoo/tools/safe_eval/ is a package at 20.0 (its __init__.py re-exports evaluation, expression and runtime); safe_eval is parsed from source by parse_odoo_core and is therefore never curated here (tests/test_parser_tools_symbols.py::TestSafeEvalImportPath). IMAGE: odoo.tools.image_process has no flat re-export at 20.0 (same as 19.0); only odoo.tools.image.image_process resolves. SUBMODULES: odoo/tools/__init__.py does not import date_utils or js_transpiler, but both files sit directly under odoo/tools/, so 'from odoo.tools import date_utils' / 'from odoo.tools import js_transpiler' resolve through Python's from-package-import submodule fallback; both are imported elsewhere in 20.0 core via their qualified path (odoo/orm/domains.py: 'from odoo.tools.date_utils import parse_date, parse_iso_date'; odoo/addons/base/models/assetsbundle.py: 'from odoo.tools.js_transpiler import ...'). Their member functions do NOT resolve flat. Every signature below is the real 20.0 parameter list (names, defaults); tests/test_tools_symbols_content_parity.py checks names, order, kinds and defaults against the live oracle. Every qualified_name is recovered by parser_tools_symbols.parse_tools_symbols against the 20.0 checkout (tests/test_tools_symbols_content_parity.py::test_curated_tools_symbols_match_live_ast_oracle_per_version).
